artifacts.summary: Close-out plan, 4 sequential phases, 2.75 hours: condensed audit evidence and dispositions for the nine filed ingredient proposals; filing P1-P9 via state-write.sh with edges P3<-P2, P4<-P3, P9<-P1 and 869<-P6; three sentence-level ROADMAP amendments (LCU as cure of record, (H5) cover ownership, R3 filing note); summary and full gate. No library change.

memory_candidates.content: Close-out plan pattern for a report-only research task whose report leaves audited task proposals behind (the research agent has no task-creation surface): (1) write a condensed audit NDJSON (non-scope-blind verdicts verbatim, scope-blind collapsed to a count, .proposal.id preserved) because state-write.sh --audit-verdict passes the file through a single jq argv and full audit lines of 140-185 KB exceed Linux's 128 KB per-argv ceiling; (2) treat overlaps-open verdicts whose shared paths are only aggregator files (docs/theorem-index.md, scripts/check-module-invariants.sh, FormalSystem.lean, module aggregators) as no-edge, since dispatch-time file_scope admission already serializes them, and add a dependency edge only for a substantive .lean overlap; (3) file proposals sequentially with --allocate-into, reading each allocated number before writing the next entry's dependencies, so inter-proposal edges can be set at creation.
